map.温度缩放 Logits 演示器，在 softmax 前对 logits 做温度缩: A temperature-scaling logits demonstrator that applies temperature scaling to logits before softmax, showing how calibration shapes the probability distribution (without changing the argmax).
map.z′ = z/T（T>1 平滑分布，T<1 锐化分布）: z′ = z/T (T > 1 smooths the distribution, T < 1 sharpens it)
map.对 logits 统一除以温度是最简单的概率校准手段，T 在验证集上用 NLL: Dividing logits uniformly by temperature is the simplest probability calibration; T is found on a validation set by NLL. It leaves the argmax and thus accuracy untouched, and only improves confidence reliability (ECE). It corrects overall over- or under-confidence but cannot fix per-class bias.
map.在 softmax 前对 logits 做 z/T，演示温度对概率形态的影响，不: Applies z/T to logits before softmax to show how temperature shapes the probabilities, without changing the argmax.
map.T>1 平滑分布(置信度降低)，T<1 锐化(更自信)，是模型校准常用手段。: T > 1 smooths the distribution (lower confidence), T < 1 sharpens it (more confident); a common calibration technique.
map.与生成温度同源：同一机制既可用于校准也可调生成多样性。: It shares its origin with generation temperature: the same mechanism serves both calibration and generation diversity.
map.：logits=[3,1,0]，T=1 概率≈[0.79,0.11,0.10]；: : with logits = [3,1,0], T = 1 gives probabilities ≈ [0.79,0.11,0.10]; T = 2 → [0.59,0.23,0.18], which is less certain. A model originally 79% confident may be closer to its true accuracy after calibration.
map.不直接提升分类准确率(argmax 不变)，只让输出置信度更'诚实'地反映正确率: It does not directly improve classification accuracy (the argmax is unchanged); it only makes the output confidence more honest about the true accuracy, which matters for applications needing reliable probabilities such as risk decisions.
map.T 用什么值校准？: What Value of T Should Be Used for Calibration?
map.在验证集上用负对数似然最小化搜索最优 T(通常略大于 1)，使预测置信度与经验准: Search for the optimal T on a validation set by minimizing negative log-likelihood (usually slightly above 1), aligning predicted confidence with empirical accuracy. It is post-processing and does not change model weights.
